$comment: Lakshly nudge catalog for the public apps. Hand-written for this repo. One nudge a day at most; every nudge explains itself and offers 'Not now'. 'masked' variants never contain amounts. roast is null where roasting isn't appropriate (debt, credit, investing).

nudges.trigger: A budgeted category has used {usedPct} of its budget by day {day} of {dim} (more than 20 points ahead of the calendar).

hype.text: Heads up! {category} is at {usedPct} of budget on day {day}. You've got this: a lighter week puts it back on track 💪
hype.masked: Heads up! {category} is running ahead of budget. A lighter week puts it back on track 💪

straight.masked: {category} is running ahead of budget this month.

roast.text: {category} is sprinting: {usedPct} gone and it's only day {day}. Maybe let it walk for a bit? 🐢
roast.masked: {category} is sprinting ahead of budget. Maybe let it walk for a bit? 🐢

nudges.trigger: Variable spend this month is {usedPct} of your usual by day {day} of {dim} (at least 15 points behind the calendar).

hype.text: Look at you! Only {usedPct} of your usual spend by day {day} ✨
hype.masked: Look at you! You're spending well under your usual pace ✨

straight.text: Month to date: {spent}, {usedPct} of your usual {usual} by day {day}.
straight.masked: You're under your usual spending pace this month.

roast.text: Only {usedPct} of your usual by day {day}? Who are you and what did you do with the old you? 😏
roast.masked: Under your usual pace? Who are you and what did you do with the old you? 😏

roast.text: {emoji} {badge} {tier} is {pct} done. It's practically begging you to finish. {hint}
roast.masked: {emoji} {badge} {tier} is {pct} done. It's practically begging you to finish. {hint}

nudges.trigger: {count} spends are waiting in this week's review.

hype.text: {count} spends are ready for a quick check. Two minutes, then inbox zero 🎉
hype.masked: {count} spends are ready for a quick check. Two minutes, then inbox zero 🎉

roast.text: {count} spends are sitting in your review, quietly judging you. Go say hi.
roast.masked: {count} spends are sitting in your review, quietly judging you. Go say hi.

nudges.trigger: {count} food-delivery orders in the last 7 days ({spent}), at least double your usual week ({usual}).

hype.text: {count} deliveries this week! Fancy a home-cooked comeback? 🍳
hype.masked: Lots of deliveries this week! Fancy a home-cooked comeback? 🍳

straight.text: {count} delivery orders in 7 days: {spent} vs about {usual} in a usual week.
straight.masked: Delivery orders are about double your usual this week.

roast.text: {count} deliveries in a week. The delivery riders know your gate code by now. 🛵
roast.masked: The delivery riders know your gate code by now. 🛵

hype.text: Free value alert! {program} points expire in {days} days 🎁
hype.masked: Free value alert! {program} points expire in {days} days 🎁
